required_fixes: R1 — High: apps/desktop/src/app.tsx:87–96, apps/desktop/src/v2/home.tsx:67–71, apps/desktop/src/v2/store.ts:87–105 and apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:105–110 admit late notifications after their scope retired. Cleanup runs only when tenant/context changes; Toasts and the unconfirmed strip subsequently render every stored entry without checking its scope. Independently reproduced with production App, DesktopClient, shell, Home and store: admit a switch to B while its observation is delayed, send an A item action from the still-rendered A view, deliver B's snapshot, then deliver the stale-context refusal or exhaust lost-result resends. B displays A's item title in a toast or a persistent Retry strip. Tenant tags alone do not prevent this. Acceptance: reject or suppress retired-scope notifications at insertion/render time; deferred refusal, failed/unknown delivery and recheck tests must show no A item/read text or retired Retry control in B or after context retirement, with normal and reduced motion, including A→B→A.

R2 — High: crates/desktop-core/src/authority/inbox_domain.rs:439–446, :465–471 and :589–599 omit pending selected products from sourcesMissing. Any established overview/product outcome makes the aggregate Done, but untouched products merely receive pending(product). A fresh multi-product tenant can therefore read only Runtime through the retained Runtime insights view (apps/desktop/src/features/runtime/overview-inbox.tsx:37–45), return Home, and be told 'all sources complete' while Red Team and model/skill remain Pending at 0 of 2 and 0 of 3 sources. A first product-only recheck has the same aggregation problem. Source tracing establishes the core result; independently rendering Home with that result reproduced the contradictory completion line and all-clear. Acceptance: production-interface tests for a standalone overview and a first single-product recheck must retain every selected unread source in aggregate coverage; Home and completion toasts must warn until every selected source is established.

R3 — Medium: crates/desktop-core/src/authority/inbox_domain.rs:417–444 filters needs-role failed attempts out of both failure time and attempted-state detection. With no Runtime overview or successful product outcome, a first Red Team/model-skill recheck whose sources all return 401/403 finishes a generation but returns aggregate Pending, lastReadAt=null and failedAt=null, despite a needsRole product result. apps/desktop/src/v2/home.tsx:40 then reports First read pending before inspecting needsRole; the Inbox also renders its never-attempted state. Acceptance: first product-only permission-denial tests, without any overview, must expose a settled attempted/needs-role result and a warning completion, preserve lastReadAt=null, and never describe the completed attempt as first-read pending or invent a successful read time.
